SPECIFICATION FOR FORCEPS, 

EYE, PERIPHERAL IRIDECTOMY (SINCLAIR’S PATTERN) 


1. Scope—Dimensional and other requirements for peripheral iridectomy forceps (Sinclair's pattern ) 
used in eye surgery.

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The arms shall be smooth and free from burrs, pits, cracks and other su-face flaws 

4.2 The teeth shall engage without over-riding, sticking or locking. 

4.3 The teeth shall be clean, bright and sharp. 

4.4 The jaws shall open and close with even movement. 


Designation 22Cr13, 30Cr13 or 
22Cr13S28 of Schedule V of 
IS : 1570-1961

IS : 5721 - 1970 


4.5 All the sharp edges, other than the teeth, shall be rounded. 

4.6 The disc shall have suitable serrations along its periphery to provide grip while tightening. 

4.7 The forceps shall be passivated and polished bright. 

5. Heat Treatment — The instrument shall be hardened and tempered to 430 to 400 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Stretch a 50 micron thick latex sheet over a finger tip. Grip the sheet by the teeth and pull to a 
distance of 5 mm. The sheet shall neither slip nor get damaged. 

6.2 Grip the joint end firmly in a vice after removing the disc mechanism. Apply a force at the tip of 
one arm to deflect it in a plane at right angles to the plane of the arm by 5 mm. Release the force. No 
permanent set shall be observed. Repeat the test on the other arm. 

6.3 Corrosion Resistance — Scrub the forceps with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water and then 
dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the forceps. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at room 
temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. 

The copper sulphate solution shall be made up as follows: 

Copper sulphate (CUSO 4 . 5 H 2 O) 4'0 g 

Sulphuric acid (H 2 S 04 )(sp gr 1'84) 10 0 g 

Water (H 3 O) 90'0 ml 

No red stains or spots on the forceps shall be allowed but dulling of the polished surface may be 
permitted. 

7. Marking — Each forceps shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The words ' stainless steel'. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1 . 

8. Packing — The forceps shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene bags, 
avoiding contact with one another, or shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the 
supplier. The teeth shall be suitably protected.
